node.title: Qfloor norm threshold is impossible at the six clean predecessors
node.statement: At the six clean candidate predecessors, the canonical qfloor parameters are (N',ell')=(256,65),(256,33),(512,33). Their strict norm thresholds (2ell')^(N'/2) have respectively 899, 774, and 1548 bits, all above 2^256. Since every official characteristic satisfies p<=q<2^256, qfloor_exact is inapplicable on all six rows. The above-budget raw binomial quotient censuses are not thereby proved to be distinct ambient slopes.
node.notes: ROUTE CUT 2026-07-26: the clean A-1 quotient multiplicities need direct-E1/value-set injectivity or a replacement collision theorem; qfloor_exact cannot supply them under the official field cap. This is not safety.
